name: @uxuiprinciples/mcp-server

tools.name: get_principle
tools.description: Get one UX/UI principle by slug: title, code, part, difficulty, summary, the bibliographic citations behind it (author, title, year, url) and the link to the full guide on uxuiprinciples.com. With UXUI_API_KEY set (pro mode) the full guide body comes back in `content`. Use it to identify, summarize or cite a specific principle; use search_principles first when you only have a topic.

slug.description: The principle slug as returned by search_principles or list_principles (e.g., "cognitive-load", "hicks-law", "fitts-law").

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

tools.name: search_principles
tools.description: Search the 195 UX/UI principles by free text, part, difficulty or tags. Returns the matching principles with slug, title, code, part name and summary, plus the total count. Use it to find which principles apply to a design question before calling get_principle.

query.description: Free-text query matched against title, slug, summary and tags (e.g., "form validation", "loading states", "choice overload").

part.description: Restrict to one part of the catalogue, by id or name (e.g., "part-1", "Foundations"). Call list_principles to see the parts.

tags.description: Restrict to principles carrying every listed tag (e.g., ["forms", "errors"]).

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

limit.description: Maximum number of principles to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: list_principles
tools.description: List the 195 UX/UI principles, optionally one part at a time. Returns principle summaries (slug, title, code, part name, summary), the total count and the list of part ids. Use it to browse the catalogue or to learn the part ids for search_principles.

part.description: Restrict to one part, by id or name (e.g., "part-1", "part-2"). Omit for every part.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

limit.description: Maximum number of principles to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_principle_prompts
tools.description: Get the ready-to-use AI prompts attached to one principle (prompts to apply, audit or refactor an interface against it). With UXUI_API_KEY set (pro mode) the prompt texts come back in `prompts`; without it the prompts belong to the paid Principles Library and the tool returns the count and the URL of the guide. Call get_principle first if you only need the summary.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

tools.name: get_smell
tools.description: Get one UX smell (interface anti-pattern) by id: name, tagline, symptoms, the Nielsen heuristic it breaks, a step-by-step fix recipe with a time estimate, the related principles and an audit prompt plus a refactoring prompt. Use it once you know the smell id, from list_smells or detect_smell.

id.description: The smell id (e.g., "overloaded-screen", "form-graveyard", "silent-errors", "ai-gradient-cliche"). Call list_smells for the full set.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

tools.name: list_smells
tools.description: List the 12 UX smells (interface anti-patterns such as overloaded screens, form graveyards, silent errors or the AI-aesthetic cliches), optionally filtered by category. Returns id, name, short name, tagline, category and Nielsen heuristic for each. Use it to browse the catalogue before get_smell.

category.description: Restrict to one category (e.g., "efficiency", "feedback", "error-prevention", "accessibility", "ai-aesthetic"). Omit for every smell.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

tools.name: detect_smell
tools.description: Detect which UX smells match a plain-language description of an interface problem or a user complaint, in English or Spanish. Returns the matched smells with a confidence level and the suggested fix for each. Use it as the first step when a UI "feels off" and the cause is not named yet; runs offline.

description.description: What is wrong, in the user's or the team's words (e.g., "users say the dashboard is too cluttered and they don't know where to start", "el formulario es demasiado largo").

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

tools.name: suggest_fix
tools.description: Get a fix for a described UX issue: detects the most likely smell (or uses the one you pass), then returns its step-by-step fix recipe, the principles to apply and a refactoring prompt you can hand to a coding agent. Use it when you want an actionable remedy rather than a diagnosis; runs offline.

issue.description: The UX issue to fix, in plain language (e.g., "the checkout asks for account creation before showing the price").

smell_id.description: Optional smell id to skip detection when the smell is already known (e.g., "dead-end-states").

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

tools.name: get_flow
tools.description: Get one user flow (onboarding, forms, pricing, dashboard, checkout, search, authentication and more) with its target metrics, the pre-flight checklist to run before designing it and the post-flight checklist to run before shipping it. Use it before designing or shipping a known flow.

id.description: The flow id. One of: "onboarding", "forms", "pricing", "dashboard", "empty-states", "checkout", "settings", "navigation", "search", "authentication", "notifications", "data-tables". Call list_flows for the current set.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

tools.name: list_flows
tools.description: List the 12 user flows covered by the checklists (onboarding, forms, pricing, dashboard, empty states, checkout, settings, navigation, search, authentication, notifications, data tables) with the target metric of each. Returns id, name, description, metric target and the number of checklist items per phase. Use it to pick the id for get_flow, generate_checklist or get_flow_principles.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

tools.name: generate_checklist
tools.description: Generate the pre-flight (before design) or post-flight (before ship) checklist for one user flow. Returns the checklist as structured items (each tied to a principle) and as ready-to-paste markdown. Use it to review a design or a pull request against the flow it implements.

flow_id.description: The flow id. One of: "onboarding", "forms", "pricing", "dashboard", "empty-states", "checkout", "settings", "navigation", "search", "authentication", "notifications", "data-tables". Call list_flows for the current set.

phase.description: Which checklist to generate: "preflight" (before design) or "postflight" (before ship).

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

tools.name: get_flow_principles
tools.description: Get the key principles that govern one user flow and the UX smells that most often break it. Returns the principle slugs and the smell ids so you can read them with get_principle and get_smell. Use it to ground a flow review in evidence.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

tools.name: audit_interface
tools.description: Audit a described screen or flow: returns findings mapped to principles and UX smells, each with severity, remediation and business impact, plus a score, the detected interface type, strengths and the three priority fixes. Pro mode only (UXUI_API_KEY set): the audit runs on the uxuiprinciples.com API. Without a key use detect_smell then suggest_fix, which run offline.

description.description: What the screen shows and what users do or complain about, 20 to 5000 characters. Name the components, the actions and the states you implemented (loading, empty, error, confirmation).

locale.description: Language of the findings: "en" or "es". Defaults to "en".

context.description: Where the interface lives. Echoed in the result; does not change the rules.

depth.description: "quick": the top 5 findings. "full": every finding. Defaults to "full".

instructions:
Provides 195 research-backed UX/UI principles, 12 UX smells (anti-patterns)
with fix recipes, and 12 user-flow checklists (onboarding, forms, pricing, checkout,
navigation and more), in English and Spanish.

Use search_principles / list_principles / get_principle to ground UI decisions in
evidence. Use detect_smell or suggest_fix when a UI has a described problem. Use
get_flow / generate_checklist before designing or shipping a known flow.

All tools are read-only. get_principle carries the citations behind each principle.
Pro mode is on (UXUI_API_KEY is set): get_principle returns the full guide body,
get_principle_prompts returns the AI prompts, and audit_interface audits a described
screen through the uxuiprinciples.com API. Everything else stays offline.
